$comment: What holds for each specification under spec/. The texts under spec/*.md are frozen at the casting named here and are not edited, apart from the status block at their top. scripts/build-spec-status.mjs writes that block, the status section of README.md and the document table of apps/site/src/content/docs/reference/specifications.md from this file; `npm run validate` checks them with --check. Where a text and the library disagree, the library with its vectors and flows holds until the text is brought up to date.

statuses.partly-built: implemented in the library in part; the note says which part
statuses.built-differently: implemented in the library with a reading other than the text; `ref` names where the reading is stated
statuses.direction-changed: the planned model differs from the text; `ref` names the direction note
statuses.not-verified: no evidence was checked for this part
